acceptance_criteria.name: completed_verified_requests
acceptance_criteria.reason: Only successfully completed, verified requests count.

acceptance_criteria.name: throughput_milestone
acceptance_criteria.reason: The milestone must be sustained after warm-up and use multiple workers.

acceptance_criteria.name: steady_state_stage_utilisation
acceptance_criteria.reason: Uses the least-utilised stage, not the mean.

acceptance_criteria.name: capacity_balance
acceptance_criteria.reason: Maximum service-capacity gap relative to the largest stage.

acceptance_criteria.name: accepted_request_completion
acceptance_criteria.reason: Completion requires successful verification.

acceptance_criteria.name: two_consecutive_capacity_doublings
acceptance_criteria.reason: Aggregate throughput is compared only at matching concurrency.

acceptance_criteria.name: nonnegative_useful_node_marginal_throughput
acceptance_criteria.reason: A negative observed step fails even if a later step recovers.

acceptance_criteria.name: capacity:model_larger_than_each_worker
acceptance_criteria.reason: Synthetic capacity evidence only.

acceptance_criteria.name: capacity:no_worker_loads_full_model
acceptance_criteria.reason: Logical memory accounting in this execution mode.

acceptance_criteria.name: capacity:distributed_real_model_valid_output
acceptance_criteria.reason: Not demonstrated by this simulation run; physical or real-model evidence is required.
acceptance_criteria.required: valid Qwen3 output from at least two workers

acceptance_criteria.name: correctness:greedy_token_identity
acceptance_criteria.reason: Not demonstrated by this simulation run; physical or real-model evidence is required.
acceptance_criteria.required: distributed token IDs exactly equal reference

acceptance_criteria.name: correctness:stage_tolerance
acceptance_criteria.reason: Not demonstrated by this simulation run; physical or real-model evidence is required.
acceptance_criteria.required: all intermediate outputs within configured tolerance

acceptance_criteria.name: correctness:cache_replay_preserves_output
acceptance_criteria.reason: A timing simulation is not numerical correctness evidence.

acceptance_criteria.name: correctness:corrupt_workers_detected
acceptance_criteria.observed: run may contain probabilistic audit events
acceptance_criteria.reason: Project acceptance is asserted by the dedicated executable test.

acceptance_criteria.name: correctness:invalid_shard_hash_rejected
acceptance_criteria.reason: Run artifacts do not replace the correctness test.

acceptance_criteria.name: scaling:two_consecutive_doublings
acceptance_criteria.reason: Simulation evidence remains labelled simulation.

acceptance_criteria.name: scaling:adding_eligible_worker_never_reduces_throughput
acceptance_criteria.reason: Compared within this run's execution mode only.

acceptance_criteria.name: scaling:stage_utilisation
acceptance_criteria.reason: Least-utilised stage during the simulated run.

acceptance_criteria.name: scaling:balanced_stage_capacity
acceptance_criteria.reason: Configured/measured service-capacity balance.

acceptance_criteria.name: throughput:20_verified_tokens_s_for_5_minutes
acceptance_criteria.reason: Execution-mode label is preserved.

acceptance_criteria.name: resilience:99_percent_completion_at_10_percent_hourly_churn
acceptance_criteria.reason: Requires the specified churn arm, not extrapolation.

acceptance_criteria.name: resilience:throughput_degradation_below_20_percent
acceptance_criteria.observed: no paired no-churn baseline in this run
acceptance_criteria.reason: A paired baseline comparison is required.

acceptance_criteria.name: resilience:failed_stage_reconstructed
acceptance_criteria.reason: Numerical replay must be demonstrated outside simulation.
acceptance_criteria.required: exact replay integration output remains correct

acceptance_criteria.name: resilience:corrupt_workers_quarantined
acceptance_criteria.observed: probabilistic simulation is not dedicated test evidence
acceptance_criteria.reason: No claim is made from an arm that may sample no corrupt operation.
acceptance_criteria.required: dedicated corruption experiment and audit evidence

limitations: Simulation results are not physical distributed performance.
Synthetic execution is not evidence of real-model kernel performance.
Configured profiles marked assumed have not been measured on physical hardware.
Aggregate throughput is not single-request generation speed.
primary_metric_definition: committed output tokens from successfully completed and verified requests divided by experiment elapsed time
